sources.entry: ConsoleMini - Controller-first big-picture launcher that turns a Mac mini into a PS1-PS4 + retro console (wraps DuckStation, PCSX2, RPCS3, shadPS4, PPSSPP, RetroArch, mGBA, Flycast). [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/momenbasel/ConsoleMini)

summary.one_liner: ConsoleMini is a controller-first, big-picture Electron launcher that turns a Mac mini into a living-room console by wrapping macOS emulators for PS1 through PS4, PSP, N64, SNES/NES, GBA and Dreamcast.
summary.what_it_does: The app provides a TV-friendly launcher built with Electron, React, Tailwind and Framer Motion, navigated with a gamepad through the HTML5 Gamepad API. It launches the appropriate emulator (DuckStation, PCSX2, RPCS3, shadPS4, PPSSPP, Mupen64Plus, RetroArch, mGBA, Flycast) with the user's own ROM. A Settings tab shows live install status and can install emulators via scripts/install-emulators.sh. Save states are not reimplemented; the app uses each emulator's native save system and provides a read-only view of the save-state folders with a Reveal in Finder button. A kiosk setup script configures auto-launch at login, disables sleep and hides the Dock.
use_cases: Turn a Mac mini into a living-room game console
Play PlayStation 1 and 2 games on a Mac
Launch multiple retro emulators from one controller-driven menu
Set up a kiosk-style emulator box attached to a TV
Browse and reveal emulator save states on macOS
Use a DualShock, DualSense, or Xbox controller to navigate emulators
notable: Controller-first big-picture UI with HTML5 Gamepad API navigation
Wraps multiple per-console emulators rather than bundling its own cores
Read-only save-state dashboard that defers to each emulator's native save system
Kiosk setup script that boots the Mac mini straight into the launcher
Apple Silicon native, codesigned, notarized builds; arm64 and x64 releases
caveats: shadPS4 PS4 emulation is experimental on macOS with thin title compatibility
PS3 via RPCS3 is heavy, and M-series hardware is recommended for PS3/PS4
Users must supply their own ROMs and BIOS files; none are included
Unsigned local builds need the quarantine attribute removed with xattr
keywords: play games on my tv with a mac
